question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I know we can count _______ Tim to resolve this for us.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**count on**" is a phrasal verb meaning to rely or depend on someone. (भरोसा करना)
 
• It is the most appropriate preposition to follow the verb "count" when expressing dependence or trust.
 
• The other options do not form correct or commonly used phrasal verbs with "count."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I know we can count **on**__ Tim to resolve this for us."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "at"** is incorrect; "count at" is not a valid phrasal structure.
 
• **Option 2: "for"** does not convey the intended meaning of reliance.
 
• **Option 4: "in"** is incorrect; while "have faith in" is valid, "count in" is not used this way.
